formulas.value: Data Transfer Efficiency (DTE): DTE = \frac{\text{SuccessPct}}{\text{ErrTally} + 1}
Bandwidth Saturation Index (BSI): BSI = \text{BwidthPct} \times \frac{\text{DataSizeMB}}{\text{DurMin}}
Risk Exposure Score (RES): RES = \text{RiskAssess} \times \text{CtrlEff}^{-1}
Compliance Cost Ratio (CCR): CCR = \frac{\text{CostUSD}}{\text{PenUSD} + 1}
Data Sensitivity Index (DSI): DSI = \text{VolGB} \times \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if DataSense = 'High'} \\ 2 & \text{if DataSense = 'Medium'} \\ 1 & \text{if DataSense = 'Low'} \end{cases}

Security Robustness Score (SRS): SRS = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if EncState = 'Full' and AclState = 'Strong'} \\ 2 & \text{if EncState = 'Full' or AclState = 'Adequate'} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
Vendor Reliability Index (VRI): VRI = \text{VendSecRate value} \times \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if ContrState = 'Active'} \\ 0.5 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
Audit Finding Severity (AFS): AFS = \frac{\text{CritFindNum}}{\text{FindTally} + 1}
Data Subject Request Load (DSRL): DSRL = \text{AccReqNum} + \text{DelReqNum} + \text{RectReqNum} + \text{PortReqNum}
Cross-Border Risk Factor (CBRF): CBRF = \text{RES} \times \begin{cases} 2 & \text{if OrigNation \neq DestNation} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
Secure Data Flow: A data flow where SRS = 3
Non-Compliant Vendor: A vendor where PolComp = 'Non-compliant' or ProcComp = 'Non-compliant'
Cross-Border Compliance Gap: A compliance record where GdprComp = 'Non-compliant' or LocLawComp = 'Non-compliant' and OrigNation ≠ DestNation
Data Integrity Failure: A data profile where IntCheck = 'Failed' or CsumVerify = 'Failed'
Overloaded Data Flow: A data flow where BSI > 50 and DTE < 1.0
DataFlow.SuccessPct: Ranges from 0 to 100%. A SuccessPct of 95% indicates reliable transfers, while <80% suggests frequent failures, from DataFlow.
RiskManagement.RiskAssess: Ranges from 0 to 100. A RiskAssess > 80 indicates high risk, while <20 suggests minimal risk, from RiskManagement.
DataProfile.VolGB: Ranges from 0 to millions. A VolGB of 1000 might represent a large dataset, while 0.1 is typical for small logs, from DataProfile.
SecurityProfile.EncState: Enum: 'Full', 'Partial'. 'Full' indicates all data is encrypted, while 'Partial' suggests gaps, from SecurityProfile.

VendorManagement.VendSecRate: Enum: 'A' = 4, 'B' = 3, 'C' = 2, 'D' or others = 1. This numeric scale quantifies vendor security, where 'A' reflects top-tier security (score 4), and lower ratings (down to 'D') indicate progressively weaker security controls.
Compliance.GdprComp: Enum: 'Compliant', 'Non-compliant', 'Partial'. 'Compliant' meets all GDPR rules, 'Non-compliant' fails key requirements, from Compliance.
AuditAndCompliance.RespTimeDay: Ranges from 0 to days. A RespTimeDay of 1.5 suggests quick responses, while >7 indicates delays, from AuditAndCompliance.
DataFlow.ErrTally: Integer ≥ 0. An ErrTally of 0 indicates flawless transfers, while >10 suggests reliability issues, from DataFlow.
RiskManagement.CtrlEff: Ranges from 0 to 100. A CtrlEff of 90% shows strong controls, while <50% indicates weaknesses, from RiskManagement.
SecurityProfile.LogRetDays: Integer ≥ 0 days. A LogRetDays of 365 meets many compliance needs, while <30 may violate regulations, from SecurityProfile.
Data Flow Reliability Score (DFRS): DFRS = \text{DTE} \times (1 - \text{RtryTally} / (\text{ErrTally} + 1))
Security Control Cost Ratio (SCCR): SCCR = \text{SRS} / (\text{CostUSD} + 1)
Vendor Compliance Burden (VCB): VCB = \text{AFS} \times (5 - \text{VendSecRate value})
Cross-Border Data Volume Risk (CDVR): CDVR = \text{CBRF} \times \text{VolGB}
Data Subject Request Pressure (DSRP): DSRP = \text{DSRL} \times \text{RespTimeDay}
Encryption Coverage Ratio (ECR): ECR = \text{SRS} \times \text{DSI}
Audit Remediation Load (ARL): ARL = \text{AFS} \times \text{DSRL}
Bandwidth Risk Factor (BRF): BRF = \text{BSI} \times \text{DSI}
Vendor Risk Amplification (VRA): VRA = \text{VRI} \times \text{RES}
High-Pressure Data Flow: A data flow where DSRP > 50 and BSI > 50
Regulatory Overload Flow: A data flow with Regulatory Risk Exposure and GdprComp = 'Non-compliant'
Bandwidth-Constrained Risk: A data flow where BRF > 100 and RES > 0.7
Incident Resolution Efficiency (IRE): IRE = \text{SLApct} / (\text{AvgResolHrs} + 1), \text{where SLApct and AvgResolHrs are from RiskManagement, adding 1 to avoid division by zero.}
Data Flow Stability Index (DFSI): DFSI = \text{DFRS} \times \frac{\text{SuccessPct}}{\text{ErrTally} + 1}
Compliance Overhead Ratio (COR): COR = \text{DSRP} / (\text{CostUSD} + 1)
Security Posture Maturity (SPM): SPM = \text{ECR} \times \frac{\text{LogRetDays}}{365}
Vendor Risk Concentration (VRC): VRC = \text{VRA} \times (1 - \text{VRI})
Cross-Border Compliance Exposure (CBCE): CBCE = \text{CDVR} \times \begin{cases} 2 & \text{if GdprComp = 'Non-compliant'} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
Incident Impact Factor (IIF): IIF = \text{RES} \times (1 - \text{IRE})
Data Retention Risk Score (DRRS): DRRS = \text{DSI} \times \frac{\text{RetDays}}{365}
Audit Compliance Pressure (ACP): ACP = \text{ARL} \times \text{AFS}
Bandwidth Compliance Risk (BCR): BCR = \text{BRF} \times \begin{cases} 1.5 & \text{if GdprComp = 'Partial'} \\ 2 & \text{if GdprComp = 'Non-compliant'} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
Vendor Security Cost Index (VSCI): VSCI = \text{VCB} / (\text{SCCR} + 1)
Vendor Compliance Risk Cluster: A vendor where VRC > 2 and VCB > 2
Incident-Prone Compliance Flow: A data flow where IIF > 0.8 and GdprComp = 'Non-compliant'

Integrity Failure Count (IFC): IFC = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if IntCheck = 'Failed'} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} + \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if CsumVerify = 'Failed'} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
Failure Types List: A comma-separated string listing failure types: 'Integrity Check' if IntCheck = 'Failed', 'Checksum Verification' if CsumVerify = 'Failed'.
High Vendor Risk Concentration: A data flow where CURRENT_DATE - RemedDue > 0
